title: thevetia humboldtii
intro: Thevetia humboldtii, commonly known as Yellow Oleander, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, known for its bright yellow flowers and toxic seeds. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Thevetia humboldtii include reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating skin conditions, while its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, caution is advised when using Thevetia humboldtii, as it can be toxic and should be handled with care.
